text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: elevated 5xx & gateway timeouts detected for ingress-gateway (region: us-east-1). error-rate > 10% over 3m, service: /v1/generate. Pager: oncall-sre.

Alice SRE: taking it. I see spike starting ~2179456700 in APM.

Frank Eng-Oncall: I'm live on this too — seeing 502s downstream from ingress to runtime pool-3, and a surge of concurrent sessions.

Bob Runtime: adding context — recent config rollout for continuous-batching landed ~30m ago to pool-3. Could be related to batching/backpressure.

Carla Infra: confirming no infra scale events, nodes in pool healthy. kube nodes 3/3 ready. autoscaler didn't trigger.

Alice SRE: quick customer-impact check: support, do we have any high-severity tickets?

Emma Support: just one enterprise customer (acme-corp) reported intermittent 502s in last 10m via support channel. No data loss reported. They saw 1-2 minute blips.

Frank Eng-Oncall: running focused queries now. top errors: 502 gateway, 504 upstream timeout, occasional 5xx from runtime (error: KV cache miss handling NPE). Logs:```json
{"ts":"2179456752","service":"ingress-gateway","status":502,"upstream":"runtime-pool-3","msg":"upstream prematurely closed connection"}
```

Bob Runtime: I can repro locally hitting pool-3 with high concurrency; runtime logs show GC pauses and occasional OOM-kill attempts on a pod. Might be memory regen issue with new batching.

Carla Infra: checking pod restarts: pod runtime-3-b8 restarted twice in last 12m, OOMKilled. Node alloc 88% memory.

Alice SRE: mitigation plan: 1) divert small percentage of traffic away from pool-3 to pool-1 & pool-2 as fallback, 2) scale up pool-3 replicas + increase memory limit, 3) temporarily roll back continuous-batching flag on pool-3. Which is fastest?

Frank Eng-Oncall: can do traffic diversion via gateway rule in 2-3m. Patch:```yaml
- route: /v1/generate
  weight:
    pool-3: 60
    pool-1: 20
    pool-2: 20
```
I'll push and monitor.

Bob Runtime: I can flip batching flag off for pool-3 in runtime config center, that should mitigate GC pressure — low-risk toggle. Will prepare command.

Carla Infra: scaling pool-3 from 4 -> 6 replicas now. K8s rollout started.

Grace DevEx: putting quick note for customer comms — minimize wording: "We observed transient request failures; engineers are mitigating; service partially degraded in us-east-1."

Dan Product: please include ETA and a note if rollbacks or traffic diversion are user-impacting.

Frank Eng-Oncall: gateway diversion applied at 2179456920. initial metrics: error-rate dropping to 6% after 30s.

Alice SRE: great. Bob — proceed to flip batching flag on pool-3?

Bob Runtime: flipping now. Command:```bash
curl -XPOST --data '{"pool":"pool-3","feature":"continuous_batching","enabled":false}' https://config.internal/api/toggles
```
Response OK 200 at 2179456965.

Frank Eng-Oncall: I see pods' memory pressure reduce after batching off, no more OOMs in last 90s. error-rate trending to baseline 1-2% at 2179457025.

Alice SRE: rollback of recent config? We'll mark as rollback of batching for pool-3 and create a targeted RCA for the batching optimization.

Emma Support: sent update to acme-corp at 2179457030. They acknowledged, appreciate quick response.

Carla Infra: pool-3 scaled to 6 replicas completed at 2179457060. no restarts since change.

Alice SRE: now moving to containment -> action items and follow-ups: 1) hotfix: keep batching off on pool-3 until runtime update (owner: Bob, due: 3h) 2) runbook update: add a step for diverting traffic weights for ingress-gateway (owner: Alice, due: 24h) 3) alert tuning: raise threshold for 5xx burst to avoid paging for short blips but add slope detection (owner: Grace, due: 48h) 4) infra: investigate memory limits / autoscaler behavior for pool replicas (owner: Carla, due: 24h) 5) customer comms note and post-incident message (owner: Dan & Emma, due: 6h).

Bob Runtime: creating PR for runtime memory handling and safer batching code path, link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4821 (WIP).

Grace DevEx: updating incident alert playbook with new threshold examples. Suggest: paging when 5xx >= 10% sustained over 5m OR spike slope > 5%/min for >3m.

Alice SRE: will open followup incident ticket and tag owners. Minor postmortem will include timeline and decision log.

Frank Eng-Oncall: quick logs snippet for the incident timeline:```text
2179456752 - first spike seen
2179456820 - pager fired
2179456920 - gateway diversion applied
2179456965 - batching flag turned off on pool-3
2179457025 - error-rate back to baseline
```

Emma Support: drafting customer-facing summary for status page and targeted msg. tagging Dan for review.

Dan Product: ack. Also request to evaluate whether rolling deploys should gate batching toggle in staging longer.

Alice SRE: agreed. After-action items: update runbook with exact gateway commands, add steward for runtime batching feature, and schedule a small canary test next rollout.

Grace DevEx: I'll add concrete alert thresholds + example command blocks to the runbook.

Carla Infra: filing infra followup with k8s metrics and pod memory heap dump request (owner: Carla).

Alice SRE: closing the live thread — monitoring for 30m. If anything regresses, re-open pager. Thanks all. :tada: 

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Channel: #incidents. Severity: Sev2. Incident ID: INC-2026-0421-78.
